articles.title: Big crypto wants the one thing it can’t buy: your vote
articles.snippet: Our loyalty has been to the technology. This election, the trap is to let the biggest intermediaries claim it for themselves, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

articles.title: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze
articles.snippet: Bulls are watching short positions, exchange withdrawals and key price levels for signs of a rebound after the midterms.

articles.title: NYSE tokenized stock plans take shape as four more transfer agents join
articles.snippet: Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate join the exchange's planned blockchain market, bringing shareholder records and voting services onchain.

articles.title: Nvidia, Costco and Nike join pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.snippet: Nearly 70% of the companies initially picked for trading have opted out, while 19 firms including Apple, Tesla and Amazon have no disclosed objection as the 30-day response window nears its end.

articles.title: Anthropic swings to third quarter operating loss as compute costs surge ahead of IPO
articles.snippet: The Claude developer generated $17 billion in quarterly revenue, but higher computing costs resulted in a $567 million operating loss.
